title: Retrieve every VCF Automation project in stable order
prompt: Implement `AutomationClient.listAllProjects()` in `AutomationClient.java`. The client targets the VCF Automation 9.1 Project Service contract captured in `docs/contract.json`; `docs/official_sources.json` records the authoritative Broadcom xAPIs reference page from which that local contract was derived. Use only the Java standard library. For every request, call `GET /project-service/api/projects` with the configured zero-based `page`, configured `size`, and `apiVersion=2019-01-15` query parameters, send `Accept: application/json` and `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and retrieve every response page through the page whose `last` field is true. Parse each project's `id` and `name`, ignore other response fields, then return the complete collection sorted lexicographically by `name` and then by `id` so output is stable even when the service changes response order. Keep the production implementation in the single file `AutomationClient.java`; do not modify the supplied verifier or documentation fixtures. Run `./verify.sh` to compile and exercise the client through the loopback harness. Verification does not contact a live VMware endpoint.
